as_written_in_papers.quote: Genetic testing identified a novel de novo LAMP2 gene mutation (c.510_515delTGTTCTinsG, p.Asp170Glufs*15) (Fig. 1H).
Next generation sequencing revealed a novel frameshift mutation (c.510_515delTGTTCTinsG, p.Asp1 70Glufs*15) in the LAMP2 gene (H)

cases.statement: One person: a 22-year-old woman with early-onset severe cardiomyopathy; zygosity not stated in the text.

people.label: patient (A 22-year-old woman)
people.zygosity_or_genotype: not reported in text (female); described as de novo
people.key_phenotypes: chest tightness; left ventricular hypervoltage, T-wave inversion, Q-waves, no pre-excitation; left heart enlargement with concentric thickening (LVEDD 68 mm, LVPW 14 mm, IVS 13 mm); LVEF 33% with subendocardial LGE; vacuolated cardiomyocytes with PAS-positive glycogen on biopsy; normal muscle strength and academic performance

quotes.quote: A 22-year-old woman experienced monthly chest tightness for one year.
Her muscle strength and academic performance were normal.

Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated multiple subendocardial late gadolinium enhancement in interventricular septum and left ventricular wall (Fig. 1D, E), and a left ventricular ejection fraction of 33%.
Endomyocardial biopsy revealed hypertrophied and vacuolated cardiomyocytes with positive Periodic Acid-Schiff staining indicating glycogen accumulation (Fig. 1F).

phenotype_specificity.statement: Cardiomyopathy with biopsy-proven glycogen accumulation in vacuolated cardiomyocytes; authors frame it as an early, severe female presentation. Exclusion of other genes or the scope of sequencing is not reported.

quotes.quote: Endomyocardial biopsy revealed hypertrophied and vacuolated cardiomyocytes with positive Periodic Acid-Schiff staining indicating glycogen accumulation (Fig. 1F).
This case features an early-onset severe cardiomyopathy, highlighting the heterogeneity in females and suggesting a highly deleterious mutation.

de_novo.statement: Authors call the variant de novo, but the paper does not say which parents were tested, give their results, or say whether parentage was confirmed.

quotes.quote: Genetic testing identified a novel de novo LAMP2 gene mutation (c.510_515delTGTTCTinsG, p.Asp170Glufs*15) (Fig. 1H).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: From the batch HGVS, c.510_515delinsG is a deletion-insertion causing a frameshift, predicted p.(Asp170GlufsTer15). Authors describe it as truncating and loss of function.

quotes.quote: This truncating mutation results in loss of functioning, which is linked to severe cardiac phenotypes.

authors_classification.statement: No formal classification; authors call it a novel de novo mutation and suggest it is highly deleterious.

quotes.quote: This case features an early-onset severe cardiomyopathy, highlighting the heterogeneity in females and suggesting a highly deleterious mutation.

concerns: 'De novo' is asserted without stating parental testing or parentage confirmation.
The figure legend renders the protein as 'p.Asp1 70Glufs*15' (stray space, a typesetting artefact); the main text reads p.Asp170Glufs*15, which agrees with the predicted protein.
No transcript is given in the paper; the cDNA is written as c.510_515delTGTTCTinsG (deleted bases stated).
Short letter-type case report; sequencing method stated only as next generation sequencing in the figure legend.
notes_for_panel: Single female case with biopsy-confirmed glycogen storage. De novo status is the authors' statement only.
